_doc: Where every SRD 5.2.1 monster lives and how it behaves (original ecology, SRD stat blocks as written). biomes: surface (meadow, forest, hills, swamp, desert, tundra, coast) and underground (caves, underdark). bands: sky, surface, caves, deeps, nadir. time: day | night | any. role: pack | solitary | leader | boss (boss: lair only). pack: [min, max] group size. minion: may spawn as a one-hit minion. leader_of: slugs it leads. brain: bruiser | skirmisher | archer | caster | heavy | swarm | lurker | flier | ambusher. hostility: hostile | neutral (only if attacked or cornered). flee: flees at low HP. spawn: wild (director) | lair (sim lairs only) | portal (extraplanar: portal site and lairs only) | people (raider packs, make_npc) | none. planes: home planes of extraplanar creatures (generic: lower, upper, elemental). medium: water (spawns only in liquid). perch: where a lurker waits (ceiling, wall, floor, burrow). bond: the rules track's Bond key that makes it non-hostile. w: weight among candidates. Drafted by rule from type, size, senses and speeds (tools note in docs/tracks/monsters.md), notable creatures hand-corrected.
